name: Pattadakal temple-complex village jolada-rotti stalls
area: Outside the Group of Monuments complex entrance, Pattadakal
signature_dish: Jolada rotti with chutney and seasonal palya
why_it_matters: Pattadakal is a UNESCO temple complex, not a town — there are no standalone restaurants in the village. Local village women set up simple stalls outside the monument complex selling jolada rotti, chutney and cooked vegetable, alongside a few shacks selling tea and snacks. This is the only food actually at Pattadakal, an honest scarcity rather than a restaurant scene.
insider_tip: Eat the jolada-rotti-and-chutney plate from the village stalls for the real local meal, or pack food — there is no AC restaurant in Pattadakal. For a proper sit-down lunch base in Badami (~22km). The roadside stalls also sell cold goli soda, welcome in the heat.
signature_address: Outside the Group of Monuments, Pattadakal, Bagalkot District, Karnataka 587116

name: Mahakuta banyan-tree thali stalls (Mahakuta — 12km foodway)
area: Mahakuteshwara Temple complex, Mahakuta village (12km from Pattadakal)
signature_dish: Village thali eaten under the banyan tree by the temple tank
why_it_matters: Mahakuta, a living Chalukya-era Shiva temple village 12km from Pattadakal, has a real pilgrim foodway: residents from the surrounding village cook at home and set up stalls under the trees by the temple tank, where pilgrims eat a traditional meal in the shade. It is the nearest genuine cooked-meal cluster to Pattadakal and a natural stop on the Badami-Pattadakal circuit.
insider_tip: Combine Mahakuta with the Pattadakal-Badami drive — the temple tank and banyan-tree meal are worth the short detour. The food is informal stall cooking, freshest around midday when pilgrim crowds arrive.
signature_address: Mahakuteshwara Temple complex, Mahakuta village, near Badami, Bagalkot District, Karnataka 587201

name: Hotel Paradise Family Restaurant (Badami base — 22km)
area: Station Road, near LIC Office, Badami town centre (22km from Pattadakal)
signature_dish: Tandoori chicken tikka with North Indian gravies
why_it_matters: Pattadakal village has zero standalone restaurants, so visitors eat in Badami, the overnight base ~22km away. Hotel Paradise is Badami's top-ranked restaurant on Tripadvisor — a family restaurant near the LIC Office serving Indian, Chinese and tandoori. Listed here explicitly as a Badami-base row for a Pattadakal day trip.
insider_tip: Do Pattadakal in the morning and lunch in Badami on the return, or pack food. The tandoori section at Hotel Paradise is the standout; it handles groups well.
signature_address: Station Road, near LIC Office, Badami town centre, Bagalkot District, Karnataka 587201

name: KSTDC Hotel Mayura Chalukya (Badami base — 22km)
area: Ramdurg Road, near Badami cave temples (22km from Pattadakal)
signature_dish: Multi-cuisine meals in the government tourism hotel garden
why_it_matters: There is no KSTDC property in Pattadakal village. The genuine KSTDC Mayura for the Chalukya triangle is Mayura Chalukya in Badami, set in a garden near the cave temples — the correct, honestly located government-hotel meal for Pattadakal visitors. Included here as a Badami-base row.
insider_tip: Quieter than Badami's Station Road strip; good for a late lunch after Pattadakal. Standard government-hotel hours — call ahead for off-season dinner timing.
signature_address: Ramdurg Road, near Badami cave temples, Badami, Bagalkot District, Karnataka 587201

name: Hotel Sanman Deluxe (Badami base — 22km)
area: Station Road, central Badami (22km from Pattadakal)
signature_dish: Jolada rotti thali with brinjal ennegai
why_it_matters: A long-running Station Road hotel-restaurant in central Badami, the base town for the Chalukya triangle. Listed here as a Badami-base option for Pattadakal visitors, who have no sit-down restaurant in their village. The North Karnataka jolada-rotti-and-ennegai meal is available alongside the standard multi-cuisine menu.
insider_tip: Ask for the local jolada-rotti thali rather than the default menu. Central on Station Road, close to the bus stand — handy for an early start to the Pattadakal-Aihole circuit.
signature_address: Station Road, central Badami, Bagalkot District, Karnataka 587201
